purpose: local functionality check, not full-data model comparison

implementation_scope.inputs: 57 shared preprocessed scalar columns, including one-hot and binary columns
implementation_scope.tokenizer: independent affine numerical token per input column, plus appended CLS token
implementation_scope.backbone: pre-LayerNorm attention except first attention; ReGLU FFN; CLS LayerNorm/ReLU/linear logit head
differences: No native categorical lookup embeddings; categorical one-hot columns are numerical tokens.
Compact architecture and shared E1 optimizer settings; not the paper hyperparameter configuration.
PyTorch MultiheadAttention instead of the authors attention module; no KV compression or CLS-only final-query optimization.
AdamW weight decay is applied to all parameters as in existing MLP training; no paper-specific parameter exemptions.

verification.test_access_guard: Guarded np.load during reload; training/resume guarded in test_ft_transformer_training_resume_and_frozen_model_match.
verification.cpu_exact_resume_test: Passed on synthetic fixture, including optimizer state and dropout trajectory via epoch-derived seeds.
